build_deepgnn_model: build a multi-layer GNN model with DeepGNN class supporting node classification and link prediction tasks
train_deepgnn_step: train the DeepGNN model by calling step method with training mode and batch data for one optimization step
evaluate_deepgnn_step: evaluate the DeepGNN model by calling step method with evaluation mode and batch data to compute loss and predictions
predict_deepgnn_probs: predict class probabilities from DeepGNN raw predictions using sigmoid or softmax based on loss type
calc_deepgnn_complexity: calculate computational complexity of DeepGNN forward pass given adjacency, features, and subgraph sizes
